messages.content:
**[Task-1] Bootstrap React + Vite project**
- Step 1: Create package.json with react, react-dom, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, tailwindcss, autoprefixer dependencies
- Step 2: Create vite.config.ts with react plugin and server port 3000
- Step 3: Create index.html with <div id="root"> and script type=module pointing to src/main.tsx
- Step 4: Create src/main.tsx with ReactDOM.createRoot mounting App component
- Step 5: Create src/index.css with Tailwind @import "tailwindcss"; directive

**[Task-2] Define chat data models and mock data**
- Step 1: Create src/types/chat.ts defining User, Message, and Conversation types
- Step 2: Create src/data/mockData.ts with sample conversations and message history

**[Task-3] Implement Chat UI components**
- Step 1: Create src/components/Sidebar.tsx to display conversation list and search filter
- Step 2: Create src/components/ChatMessage.tsx for rendering message bubbles, timestamps, and avatars
- Step 3: Create src/components/ChatInput.tsx for message composition with keyboard shortcuts and action buttons
- Step 4: Create src/components/ChatWindow.tsx to assemble header, scrollable message feed, and input box

**[Task-4] Assemble main Chat application**
- Step 1: Implement src/App.tsx managing active conversation, message dispatching, and responsive layout
- Step 2: Validate & install dependencies

### 🚀 Build & Compilation Report

All tasks completed and verified in **32s**.

#### 📑 Accomplished Tasks:
• All workspace modifications applied successfully.

🔄 **Git Sync**: Successfully committed and pushed to remote repository (`https://github.com/stevenokano8-wq/Trinitycodingagent.git`).

---
### ⚙️ Environment & External Source Connection (.env)
To automatically push builds or sync this project with external repositories and live production origins, configure your environment parameters below:

| Environment Variable | Description / Purpose | Connection Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `GITHUB_REPO_URL` | Target repository URL (e.g. `https://github.com/org/repo.git`) | ✅ Connected |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | GitHub Access Token with write permissions | ✅ Authenticated |
| `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` | API key for direct Cloudflare Edge deployment | ⚡ Optional |
| `GEMINI_API_KEY` | Key for server-side generative AI features | ✅ Present |

*To link your project to a remote git origin, add `GITHUB_REPO_URL` and `GITHUB_TOKEN` to your project secrets or `.env` file.*
